incidents.name: Fortress Loans Chain price-feed submit() without signature verification
incidents.notes: The Chain price-feed contract read by FortressPriceOracle had the validator-signature require in submit() commented out, so the attacker pushed an arbitrary FTS price and, with a governance proposal that had already made fFTS collateral, borrowed the protocol dry.

sources.ref: onchain review: Chain contract 0xc11B687cd6061A6516E23769E4657b6EfA25d78E created 2021-12-13T14:05:40Z by 0xa6e4ffa19b213abea258ae72e8e1a209b9e543e7, unrelated to attack sender 0xa6af2872176320015f8ddb2ba013b38cb35d22ad; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss verified onchain: the exploit transaction moved 418,909.95 BUSD, 40,989.35 USDT, 25,362.50 USDC, 22.73 BTCB and 161.21 ETH into the attack contract 0xcd337b920678cf35143322ab31ab8977c3463a45, matching the reported ~$3.0M.
